title: CREATING THE PLAYER CHARACTER - the OA arc opener: the front-matter doctrine (the European monk retired for the oriental monk, the Kara-Tur naming, the honor thesis), the four generation methods, the NPC generation rules, the wish-on-ability-scores ladder, and the Strength yardstick pins
audit_anchor: // ---- R227: the wis mental save wiring audit ----
audit_comment: OA round one (capture pp. 1-8): the arc opener - the front-matter doctrine (the monk retirement, the Kara-Tur naming, the honor thesis), the four generation methods with the NPC rules and the wish ladder, and the Strength yardstick with its exceptional-Strength ladder.
include_after: #include "rules/dmoduelroster.h"  // R613: the DMO spell dueling roster pins

consts.name: dgaMethodCount
consts.comment: the four PC generation methods offered for creating player characters (capture p. 6)

consts.name: dgaWishLowCeiling
consts.comment: the wish ladder boundary: a wish or alter reality raises a score of 3-15 by one full point (capture p. 6)

consts.name: dgaWishesFrom16To17
consts.comment: the printed wish example: nine more wishes are needed to reach 17 after the first one-tenth step (capture p. 6)

consts.name: dgaPressLbsPerPoint
consts.comment: the military-press yardstick: 10 pounds lifted per point of Strength (capture p. 7)

consts.name: dgaBodyWeightCap
consts.comment: the overhead ceiling: no human or humanoid presses more than twice its own body weight (capture p. 7)

consts.name: dgaExceptionalLift
consts.comment: the Strength 18/00 maximum military press in pounds (capture p. 7)

consts.name: dgaBushiXpFloor
consts.comment: the bushi Strength prime-requisite floor for the experience bonus (capture p. 7)

bools.name: dgaMonkRetired
bools.comment: the preface doctrine: remove the monk from European-type campaigns - what is found herein is superior and in the proper surroundings (capture p. 3)

bools.name: dgaKaraTurNamed
bools.comment: the Kara-Tur framework: the book names Shou Lung, T'i Lung and Kozakura as the modeled lands (capture p. 5)

bools.name: dgaHonorThesis
bools.comment: the honor thesis: social skills and personal honor are as important as combat abilities (capture p. 5)

bools.name: dgaMethodI
bools.comment: Method I: roll 4d6 discard the lowest, total the rest, six times, assign the six results freely (capture p. 6)

bools.name: dgaMethodII
bools.comment: Method II: roll 3d6 twelve times, retain any six scores, assign as desired (capture p. 6)

bools.name: dgaMethodIII
bools.comment: Method III: roll 3d6 six times, assign one result to Strength, then repeat per ability in order (capture p. 6)

bools.name: dgaMethodIV
bools.comment: Method IV: roll 3d6 in ability order to create twelve characters, then choose the preferred one (capture p. 6)

bools.name: dgaNpcAveraging
bools.comment: the run-of-the-mill NPC rule: roll 3d6 per ability, counting any 1 as 3 and any 6 as 4 (capture p. 6)

bools.name: dgaNpcProfessionBoost
bools.comment: the special-character rule: profession abilities roll 3d6 with +1 added to each die that rolls 5 or less (capture p. 6)

bools.name: dgaWishHighTenth
bools.comment: the wish rule above the boundary: scores of 16 or better rise only one-tenth of a point per wish (capture p. 6)

bools.name: dgaWishBooksExempt
bools.comment: the wish exemption: magical books and devices can still raise scores of 16 or better a full point (capture p. 6)

bools.name: dgaPressOrBodyWeight
bools.comment: the 18-Strength press: 180 pounds or own body weight, whichever is greater (capture p. 7)

bools.name: dgaExceptionalLiftLadder
bools.comment: the exceptional-Strength lift ladder: 1 pound per percentage point 1-50, 4 pounds per point 51-90, 8 pounds per point 91-100 (capture p. 7)

bools.name: dgaBushiXpBonus
bools.comment: the bushi prime requisite: Strength 15 or more earns a 10 percent experience bonus (capture p. 7)

bools.name: dgaExceptionalClasses
bools.comment: the exceptional-Strength roll: samurai, kensai, barbarians and bushi with Strength 18 roll percentile dice (capture p. 7)

table_checks.note: the press yardstick consistency, Strength 3 and 18 (capture p. 7)
the exceptional ladder sums to the 18/00 press (capture p. 7)
the wish ladder boundary cross-check (capture p. 6)
